_doc: Reviewed plain-language summaries, keyed by provision id (e.g. "s47-3"). scripts/ingest_act.py merges these into data/provisions.js so they survive re-ingest. Add an entry only after a reviewer has checked it against the official text; Pidgin (pcm) entries also need a native-speaker check. Without a summary, AIVD shows the official wording with a short lead sentence. Example: "s47-3": { "en": "...", "pcm": "...", "reviewed_by": "name", "reviewed_on": "2026-12-01" }
